note: PaveDB configuration schema: the single source of truth for config keys, their defaults, and descriptions. Edit only to add or change a config field, then run `make docs-refresh` to regenerate config.yml.example and docs/reference/config.md. This is NOT an operator tuning file and is not meant to be edited while running: configure a live instance via config.yml or PAVEDB_* environment variables.

fields.description: Root directory for local catalog, metadata, document chunks, and indexes. When omitted at runtime, defaults to the instance home data directory.
Allow searches to include the configured common collection when requested.
Tenant that owns the common collection.
Collection name used for common shared results.
Enable persisted query history and query-home lookup pointers.
Enable development startup behavior such as allowing auth.mode=none on loopback and verbose PaveDB logging.
Authentication mode. Use static outside dev; none is accepted only under the startup policy's dev safeguards.
Tenant label assigned to unauthenticated requests when auth.mode is none.
Bearer token that grants admin access when auth.mode is static.
Map of tenant name to bearer token when auth.mode is static.
Optional sidecar YAML file containing auth.api_keys and tenants.* values.
Vector store backend used for local indexes.
Default embedder selector. Use a user-defined instance key, type, type:model, or full vector key. Required when more than one embedder instance is configured.
Warm the default embedder at server startup before the first query. Null uses the startup policy: enabled outside dev, disabled in dev.
Built-in native embedder instance type. Native means PaveDB runs the embedder itself rather than calling an external service.
Default sentence-transformers model for the native instance.
Native SBERT runtime mode: auto, process, or direct.
Optional native SBERT device override; cpu | cuda | mps | auto lets the adapter choose.
Optional native SBERT encode batch size; null uses the adapter default.
Native SBERT process worker count; auto picks a conservative local default capped for mixed search/ingest tail stability.
Reject document uploads larger than this many megabytes; 0 disables the limit.
Maximum number of concurrent ingest operations; 0 disables the cap.
Maximum number of concurrent search operations; 0 disables the cap.
Per-search timeout in milliseconds; 0 disables the timeout.
Plain-text chunk size in characters.
Plain-text chunk overlap in characters.
Default per-tenant concurrent request cap; 0 disables the cap.
Default server bind host after startup policy enforcement.
Default server bind port.
Enable uvicorn reload when running the packaged server.
Number of uvicorn worker processes.
Uvicorn keep-alive timeout in seconds.
Base stderr log level.
Destination for structured operation logs: null/off, stdout, or a file path.
Destination for uvicorn access logs: null/off, stdout, or a file path.
Logger namespaces forced to DEBUG level.
Logger namespaces made one level more verbose than the base log level.
Noisy dependency logger namespaces made one level quieter than the base log level.
Display instance name used by the API metadata and UI.
Description used by the API metadata and UI.
